sources.title: DedeProGames/SoralASR-23M-Preview · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: SoralASR-23M-Preview is a compact English automatic speech recognition model with 23,062,272 parameters. It uses a reduced Whisper-style encoder-decoder architecture and was trained from randomly initialized ASR weights.
